observed_evidence.claim: The Department of the Air Force selected three companies to potentially develop and operate a microreactor on a DAF installation, with Buckley Space Force Base, Colorado, and Malmstrom Air Force Base, Montana, as the first two sites.
observed_evidence.source_name: DAF announces next steps in Advanced Nuclear Power for Installations initiative  > Air Force > Article Display

observed_evidence.claim: Fort McCoy opened a new microgrid to strengthen energy resilience at its main gate.
observed_evidence.source_name: Fort McCoy opens new microgrid to strengthen energy resilience at main gate > U.S. Army Reserve > News-Display

observed_evidence.claim: The Department of Defense broke ground on the Project Pele transportable microreactor at Idaho National Laboratory, a potential first advanced reactor to operate in the United States as early as 2026.
observed_evidence.source_name: Department of Defense Breaks Ground on Project Pele Microreactor | Department of Energy

observed_evidence.claim: The Department of the Air Force is planning its first nuclear microreactor at Eielson Air Force Base in Alaska, in a pilot program with Oklo, Inc., targeting 1 MW to 5 MW of electricity by 2027.
